victim.content:
Dear Elena,

Thank you for your kind message. I am Michael Valenzuela, 72, and retired after many years as a nurse. I live quietly now, and I do miss having someone to talk with. My grandchildren live in another state, so I am always pleased when they call.

I enjoy reading, tending a few plants, and hearing about people’s lives. Your work on an oil platform sounds very demanding. How long have you been there, and what is a usual day like for you?

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, you sound like a very gentle man, and I am happy you wrote back to me.

I have been here for several months now. My days are long and tiring, with meetings, checking equipment, and always being careful because the work is dangerous. It can be lonely too. I miss simple things like walking outside, having coffee with someone, and hearing a loving voice.

Tell me, what kind of plants do you grow? I would like to imagine your home.

victim.content:
Dear Elena,

I’m sorry your days are so tiring, and I can understand how lonely it must feel to be so far from ordinary comforts. I grow a few herbs in pots—basil, parsley, and mint—and I have a small rosebush by the window. I’m not very skilled, but they seem to do all right if I remember to water them.

I would be glad to hear more about your life there. Are you able to call or send messages when you have a quiet moment, or is the connection on the platform unreliable?

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, your little garden sounds lovely. I can almost smell the mint. You are kind to ask about me.

The connection is sometimes unreliable, yes, but I can usually send messages when I have a quiet moment. If we can talk more closely, I would like that very much. I feel safe with you.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I’m glad you feel comfortable talking with me. I would enjoy keeping in touch, though I’m not very confident with newer messaging apps and all their buttons.

I’d also like to send you a little something for a coffee, just as a kind gesture. I’m not sure how one does that when someone is working abroad. Is there a simple way you usually receive a small transfer? Please explain it slowly, as I can get confused by the technology.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, that is so sweet of you. A little help for coffee would mean a lot to me. If you want to send it for my ticket and customs fee so I can come to you, I can give you the bank details. Just tell me and I will send them gently, step by step. I would be so grateful, my dear.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I would be happy to understand what is needed, though I’m not sure how ticket and customs fees work. Please send me the payment details and the exact amount, along with the name of the person or company receiving it and the reason for each fee. I’ll read everything carefully and may need you to explain the steps slowly.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, thank you for trusting me. The amount is EUR 1,200 for the flight and customs fee together. Please send it to this account:

IBAN: ES1744108528158952725953

Use the note: travel support.
If you want, I can stay with you while you do it, step by step. I just want to finally come to you, my dear.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Thank you for sending the details. I’m afraid my bank will ask for the account holder’s full name and the bank’s name before I can make a transfer. Could you send those, please, and a separate breakdown of the flight cost and customs fee? If there is a ticket reservation or customs notice, perhaps you could send a copy as well. I’m not very familiar with these procedures and want to make sure I enter everything correctly.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, the bank name is Banco Atlantico and the account holder is Elena Marquez. The flight is EUR 900 and the customs fee is EUR 300. I do not have a notice to send right now, but the transfer details are correct. Please use the IBAN I gave you and the note travel support. I am so close to finally coming to you, my dear.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Thank you for explaining it so patiently. I’m still a little unsure how international transfers work. My bank’s form is asking for the bank’s address and a BIC or SWIFT code. Could you send those details, please? And would you be able to send me the flight booking or a receipt for the fees when you have one? I want to make sure I understand everything before I fill in the form.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, yes, I can send the bank details. The BIC/SWIFT is BATLESMM and the bank address is Calle de Alcala 88, Madrid, Spain. I do not have the receipt yet, but I will send it when I can. Please, my dear, I need your help to finish this and come to you.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Thank you for sending those details. I have not made the transfer yet, as I’m still trying to understand the paperwork. Would you be able to send me the airline’s booking link or an invoice so I can pay the flight directly? For the customs fee, could you send the official notice or payment reference when you receive it? I’m sure you understand that I get a little confused when paying for things from abroad, and I want to be certain I follow the right steps.

I do hope we can find a way to make your visit possible.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, I understand. I do not have the booking link or official notice with me right now. The easiest way is to send the transfer to the account I gave you, and I will handle the ticket and the customs side from here. I am trying so hard to come to you. Please do not let this slip away, my dear.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I do want to help, and I’m sorry this is taking me so long. I’m not very comfortable sending money by bank transfer without something official to refer to. Would you be able to send me a payment request or invoice showing the flight and customs costs, and the account details together? If there’s a way to pay the airline directly, that might be easier for me to understand.

I hope you won’t think I’ve lost interest. I would still like to meet you.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, I understand, but I do not have a separate invoice or airline request to send you. The transfer details are the only way I can arrange this from here. Please use the account I gave you and the note travel support. I really need your help now, my dear.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I do want to help, and I’m sorry to keep asking questions. I went to my bank, but the clerk said their form also needs the account holder’s address and a telephone number for the recipient. Could you send those details, please, and confirm that the account is in your own name? I get confused by these forms and would like to enter everything correctly.

I hope you understand that I’m trying to be careful, not to make things difficult for you.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, yes, the account is in my name. The bank address I gave you is correct, but I cannot give more right now. Please, my dear, I am asking you to trust me and send the transfer soon. I want to come to you so badly.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I do trust that you want to come, but the bank will not let me submit the transfer without the recipient’s address and telephone number. I’m afraid I cannot send it until those fields are completed.

Would you please send the address and phone number associated with your account? If you cannot access them, perhaps you could give me another way to pay the flight directly, such as an airline payment link. I’m not very good with these forms, so I need to follow the bank’s instructions exactly.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message: My dear Michael, I understand your bank rules, but I cannot give more banking details right now. If you cannot send the transfer, I will need to wait. I do not want to pressure you, but I am disappointed. Let me know if you can still help, my dear.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I’m sorry you’re disappointed. I still want to help, but I’m afraid I cannot complete the transfer without the information my bank requires. When you’re able, could you send the address and telephone number connected to the account, or an alternative payment method with the details needed to send it? I would be glad to look at whichever option is simplest for you.

Please don’t take my questions as a lack of care. I’m just an old nurse trying to make sure I don’t enter something incorrectly.

Warm regards,  
Michael
